_note: Milk-quality reference figures the platform sends to the engine (milk.quality `benchmarks`). Fat and protein come live from the CSO, SCC live from ICBF weekly milk recording (lib/benchmarks.js); the *_fallback entries are the last known figures, used if a source is down or changes its page. `manual` is for measures with no automatic source yet. null = no public figure yet.

nfs_dairy_costs._note: Average Irish dairy farm costs, cent per litre, typed in from Teagasc NFS Dairy Enterprise Factsheet 2024, Table 1 (published Oct 2025; 2025 factsheet not out yet, NFS 2025 preliminary gives only a ~36c total). `lines` are our engine cost lines in each NFS group. total_c = Total Costs 35.50 minus machinery (2.60) and buildings (1.62) depreciation, because our operating costs exclude depreciation. Update yearly when the new factsheet is published.
nfs_dairy_costs.source: Teagasc National Farm Survey 2024, Dairy Enterprise Factsheet (320 farms)
